data.long_meaning: The name Jez is derived from the Hebrew word ‘ez, which means ‘rock’ or ‘solid foundation’. In the Bible, Jez is used as a short form of several names, including Jehoshaphat (‘Jehovah judges’) and Joram (‘not exalted’). The name Jez symbolizes strength, stability, and God’s protection. The name Jez carries the meaning “God is my rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
